mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to remodel a kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a kitchen remodel depends on various factors, including the size of the kitchen, the quality of materials selected, and the extent of structural changes. A minor refresh might involve new countertops and appliances, while a major renovation could include new cabinet layouts, flooring, and reconfigured plumbing or electrical. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation and design discussion, ensuring transparency regarding all expenses.
